# Async report generator

*Client industry: SaaS | Completed: 2021-10-01 | Evidence id: ai_ml:case:p05*

## The problem
The client was an analytics product whose PDF exports timed out.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Python scripts, Celery, Redis, a typed async Python web API, containerised deployment. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project moved exports to the background with zero timeouts in a month.
